title: Tamagawa number formula for Jacobians
summary: We give a product formula for the Tamagawa numbers of Jacobians over a discrete valuation field with perfect residue field k. It comes as a product of four terms - unipotent, toric, arithmetic and (somewhat intricate) cohomological.
